reviewer.identity: gpt-6-astra high independent image-pair evidence; /root/vision_exemplars delegated acceptance review

role_and_message.evidence: The image-to-segmentation architecture remains intact: image features combine with averaged visual/text embeddings, then pass through convolution and progressive CVGD decoding.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All three encoders, image and prompt examples, E/V/T representations, averaging node, D1–D3 stages, output segmentation, and expanded decoder panel are retained.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: E2–E4, V2–V4, E, V, T, R, cost-volume labels, decoder indices, and module names remain legible and unchanged. The template 'a photo of a {cat}' is preserved.

connections_and_direction.evidence: E4/V4 feed D1, E3/V3 feed D2, and E2/V2 feed D3 as originally shown. V and T feed Avg; R joins E at the cost-volume operation. The inset preserves HD Conv → MLP → Self Att → MLP → Upsample, with image and visual-cost branches joining C before Conv.

visual_encodings.evidence: Red visual-feature indices, yellow visual embeddings, blue text embeddings, pink decoder stages, and flame/snowflake placements are preserved. Added footer colors distinguish explanatory steps without redefining existing encodings.

examples_and_data.evidence: The input cat photograph, stacked cat prompts, and segmentation example are preserved, including building, tree, wall, wood, cat, and grass class labels. No new measurements or outcomes appear.

unsupported_additions.evidence: The three added footer statements are supported: template-generated visual prototypes by Section 4.1; averaged V/T representation R and dual-prompt cost volume by Section 4.1; progressive multi-scale image/visual-prompt decoding by the caption and Section 4.2.

complete_visible_content.evidence: The derivative full image contains the entire architecture, decoder inset, examples, and all three footer statements without visible clipping or corrupted text. Partial content at detail-crop boundaries is present in the full image.

remaining_limitations: Assessment uses the supplied images and source text. The reported pixel proof supports only its listed rectangle; its file and hash were not independently verified. Retained source resolution and visual blemishes are independently scored; no quality-informed reroll.
caption:
Figure 4. Architecture of our DPSeg network. We begin by generating visual prompts based on text prompt templates, which are then
combined with text prompts to create the dual-prompt cost volume. Subsequently, we incorporate multi-scale image features and corre-
sponding visual prompt embeddings into the cost volume-guided decoder (CVGD) in a progressive manner.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed complete final and source caption/evidence. Full original DPSeg graph preserves three encoders, E/V/T average and cost volume, E4/V4→D1,E3/V3→D2,E2/V2→D3 and all decoder-inset math. Caption/Sec4.1 support template-produced visual prototypes and V+T average; progressive CVGD summary matches original. Cat images/masks/labels untouched.
